key_reasoning.reason: Bumped L to XL: the change touches the workflow router (create/update/new upload route), the new workflow_icon_service, WorkflowConfig model and queries, and download_rules.py, which is the shared file-download authorization used by every stored file. Reuses FileRepositoryFactory from the shared storage layer.

Acceptance is concrete in code: MIME allow-list and 2 MB limit, extension and magic-byte checks, canonical URL write-back, and the read/edit gates. Design decisions (reuse of the assistant icon mechanism, no migration) were resolved in the diff, so clarity is M rather than L.

Security-sensitive file upload: content sniffing, extension-to-type checks, size cap, and uuid4 names with a fullmatch name regex. Authorization changed on both sides: icon URL reuse requires READ on a referencing workflow, and icon reads go through the Ability check in download_rules. No exact precedent, so the base is L and the auth and upload red flags bump it to XL.

9 files in the diff: 2 new (workflow_icon_service.py, test_workflow_icon_service.py) and 7 modified (router, workflow_config, download_rules, openapi baseline, and 3 test modules). Falls in the 7-10 band, which maps to L.

Four layers: API (router endpoint and validation), Service (icon service and download rules), DB-Persistence (get_by_icon_url query on the existing icon_url column, no schema change), and Infrastructure (file storage repository). Four layers, but no migration, so L rather than XL.
No new packages or manifest changes. Only the OpenAPI baseline JSON is updated for the new route.
